evidence.negative_value_interpretation: Provider-corresponding computed net boundary flux; neither measured negative river inflow nor an identified loss process.
evidence.flags_reference: Current provider-native storage/flow accounting; archival revision differences remain unresolved. Conservative review exclusions, not declarations of bad measurements.

interval_inputs.date_policy: Preserve canonical calendar labels; do not infer physical clock or DST durations from API timestamps.
interval_inputs.negative_value_policy: Preserve sign and daily volume under explicit computed-net semantics.
interval_inputs.observation_version: Packaged canonical legacy SI; current RISE records remain separate source evidence.

quarantine.storage_endpoint_policy: Quarantine both endpoints of every flagged transition; neither endpoint is proven erroneous.
quarantine.dependent_interval_policy: Exclude every simulated interval touching a quarantined storage endpoint.
quarantine.calendar_policy: Keep every source row and value; use eligibility masks and contiguous clean blocks.
quarantine.repair_policy: No storage interpolation, flow replacement, invented correction, or residual-derived fitted loss.

future_simulation.restart_storage: First clean observed storage after quarantine, explicitly provisional and unscored.
future_simulation.first_block_storage: First packaged observed storage, also an unscored provisional anchor.
future_simulation.restart_release: Evaluate the operating rule at the restart storage; do not treat observed daily-mean QD as an endpoint rate.
future_simulation.release_comparison: Observed daily mean versus modeled integrated interval-average release.
future_simulation.metrics: Pool eligible pairs within each protocol phase; report block support separately; do not average block NSE.
future_simulation.spinup_interpretation: Only model storage and rule-consistent endpoint release initialize a block. Initialization sensitivity must be reported; conditional restarts are not equivalent to a fresh free-running validation.
future_simulation.sensitivity_interpretation: Predeclared robustness perturbations, not measurement uncertainty bounds; do not choose a scenario using validation fit.
future_simulation.infeasible_input_policy: Report infeasible storage/flux/root conditions; do not silently clip signed volume or repair targets.
future_simulation.remaining_implementation: Interval-volume solver and segmented pooled objective must consume this policy before any optimization.
